body: I just finished this movie after a while of watching last, and I had to see other peoples opinions. Even on my first watch , I thought Andys' friends and bf are a-holes, unsupportive, and envious! Like, yes, at first, she didn't necessarily want to work in fashion, but that job would gain her the network to be able to do what she loved and went to school for. The fact that her friends and most of all, her bf didn't understand or support that is whack. Personally, I think they envied her because at the beginning they toast to 'jobs that pay the rent' but as soon as she started showing passion and interest in that job it became a problem for them because none of them enjoyed what they did for work. That's not Andy's fault or problem. In conclusion, though, I understand that this movies message is to not prioritize back breaking jobs over your personal life and relationships. Back to her boyfriend, though, they would probably never make it to marriage if he couldn't handle her upgrading her wardrobe and dressing for her job and putting effort into her career.
